notes: Text to Video safety + standalone screen. (1) Start Production now shows a localised 'Replace your current scenes?' confirmation when scenes already exist (sdSegments.length > 0) — Text to Video regenerates the whole project from the script and overwrites every scene, so this stops accidental wipes. Cancel aborts before anything starts; 'Replace scenes' (red) proceeds. EN + JA (ttv_replace_title/body/cancel/proceed). (2) In Scene (list) view, Text to Video now takes over the content area as its own screen instead of sitting inline above the scenes: body.ttv-screen hides the scene panel AND the fixed bottom timeline dock, so it can't be mistaken for part of the scene list (the cause of earlier 'where did my content go' confusion). Added a × close button to the panel header; closing or switching tabs exits the screen and restores the scenes + dock. Timeline view is unchanged — still a centered modal (now 760px). Verified both views, EN+JA confirm, Cancel gating (no start-batch emitted), and clean restore; no console errors.
